description: Plugin filtering and preferences for Jarvis Ableton

blacklist.description: Plugins to never load (unlicensed, problematic, etc.). Do not blacklist installed paid plugins just because a stock fallback exists.

prefer_native.description: Prefer Ableton native devices only when they are the best sonic choice, explicitly requested, or the relevant paid/third-party plugin is unavailable.

plugin_selection_policy.description: Creative production requests should choose the best available installed plugin for the musical job, not the safest stock default.

rules.default: Research the sound goal and inspect config/vst_cache.json before loading effects. Prefer the strongest owned/installed paid or specialist plugin when it clearly fits the request.
rules.stock_fallback: Use Ableton stock devices only when they are genuinely the best option, when a specialist plugin is unavailable/unverified, or when Isaiah asks for stock/native devices.
rules.bass: For bass tone, check installed specialist bass/amp tools first: Guitar Rig 6, Waves Voltage Amps Bass, CLA Bass, JJP-Bass, RBass, MaxxBass, and Bass Rider.

instrument_source_policy.description: For musical instruments, prefer Isaiah's trusted Native Instruments/Kontakt favorites over generic stock devices or random third-party plugins.

rules.piano: Use Kontakt starred/favorite pianos first. Do not substitute Drift, stock Piano, Keyscape, or Waves sampled keys unless Isaiah explicitly asks.
rules.keys: Use Kontakt or Komplete Kontrol favorites first for keys, Rhodes-like parts, and soft pads.
rules.strings: Use Kontakt favorites or installed Kontakt string libraries first for strings.
rules.fallback: If a Kontakt favorite cannot be loaded or verified, stop and report the blocker instead of silently choosing a random instrument.

fallback_mappings.description: When a blacklisted plugin is requested, use these native alternatives

warn_on_unavailable.description: Warn user when a suggested plugin is unavailable

user_notes.description: Add notes about your plugin situation here
user_notes.notes: 2026-05-27: Isaiah corrected the workflow: do not default to stock Ableton plugins when a better installed paid/specialist plugin is available. Inventory and research first, then pick the best plugin for the sound.
